description: Metis 插件版 - Source of Truth Frameworks Contract (16 Core Frameworks)

frameworks.name: Targeted Apply Framework
frameworks.description: Mechanically apply a fully specified change without design decisions.

frameworks.name: Backend Build Framework
frameworks.description: Compile, bundle, and resolve dependencies for backend systems.

frameworks.name: Backend Defect Repair Framework
frameworks.description: Root-cause diagnosis, test reproduction, and verified defect repair.

frameworks.name: Backend Implementation Framework
frameworks.description: Implement new backend services, models, and endpoints.

frameworks.name: Architectural Composition Framework
frameworks.description: Multi-module architecture, service wiring, and cross-cutting concerns.

frameworks.name: Documentation Framework
frameworks.description: Author, update, and audit technical documentation.

frameworks.name: Frontend Build Framework
frameworks.description: Compile, bundle, and resolve UI assets and client applications.

frameworks.name: Frontend Defect Repair Framework
frameworks.description: Diagnose and fix UI/UX bugs, layout breaks, and client state issues.

frameworks.name: Frontend Implementation Framework
frameworks.description: Build responsive UI components, state management, and user interactions.

frameworks.name: Frontend Review Framework
frameworks.description: Visual, accessibility, performance, and code quality review for UI.

frameworks.name: Code Generation Framework
frameworks.description: Generate scaffolding, boilerplate, schemas, and typed contracts.

frameworks.name: Architecture Design Planning Framework
frameworks.description: System design, interfaces, tradeoffs, and structural planning.

frameworks.name: Deep Codebase Research Planning Framework
frameworks.description: Ground truth discovery, dependency analysis, and exploration.

frameworks.name: Scope Decomposition Planning Framework
frameworks.description: Decompose complex mission into disjoint bounded lanes and roadmaps.

frameworks.name: Quality Polish Framework
frameworks.description: Code aesthetics, comments, formatting, typing, and cleanup.

frameworks.name: Safe Refactoring Framework
frameworks.description: Restructure existing code safely with invariant protection.
